mapper.sql: ppl.period_permission_link_id as "periodPermissionLinkId", ppl.business_period_id as "businessPeriodId", ppl.function_permission_id as "functionPermissionId", fp.screen_id as "screenId", coalesce(m.menu_name, fp.screen_id) as "screenName", fp.role_code as "roleCode", r.role_name as "roleName", fp.function_type as "functionType", fp.permission_allowed as "permissionAllowed", ppl.effective_start_at as "effectiveStartAt", ppl.effective_end_at as "effectiveEndAt", case when CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < ppl.effective_start_at then 'BEFORE' when ppl.effective_end_at is not null and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP > ppl.effective_end_at then 'AFTER' else 'ACTIVE' end as "periodState", case when fp.permission_allowed = 'ALLOW' and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= ppl.effective_start_at and (ppl.effective_end_at is null or CURRENT_TIMESTAMP <= ppl.effective_end_at) then true else false end as "effectiveAllowed", ppl.change_reason as "changeReason", ppl.updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
select from period_permission_links ppl join function_permissions fp on fp.function_permission_id = ppl.function_permission_id left join menus m on m.screen_id = fp.screen_id and m.status = 'ACTIVE' left join roles r on r.role_code = fp.role_code
order by ppl.business_period_id, fp.screen_id, fp.role_code, fp.function_type limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select count(*) from function_permissions where function_permission_id = #{functionPermissionId}

select from period_permission_links ppl join function_permissions fp on fp.function_permission_id = ppl.function_permission_id left join menus m on m.screen_id = fp.screen_id and m.status = 'ACTIVE' left join roles r on r.role_code = fp.role_code where ppl.business_period_id = #{businessPeriodId} and ppl.function_permission_id = #{functionPermissionId}
mapper.insert: insert into period_permission_links (business_period_id, function_permission_id, effective_start_at, effective_end_at, period_state, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{businessPeriodId}, #{functionPermissionId}, #{effectiveStartAt}, #{effectiveEndAt}, #{periodState}, #{changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (business_period_id, function_permission_id) do update set effective_start_at = EXCLUDED.effective_start_at, effective_end_at = EXCLUDED.effective_end_at, period_state = EXCLUDED.period_state, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
